 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
 Cra No. 3280 of 2022
 (Narendra @ Talli Lodhi And Others Vs The State Of
 Dated : 12-07-2024
 Mr. Shobhendra Kumar Tiwari - Advocate for the appel
 Mr. Rajesh Shukla - Additional Advocate General for 
State.
Heard on I.A No.12814/2024, which is an application seeking correction of typographical mistake in
para - 2 of the order dated 31.05.2024.

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The appellant No.1 has been convicted under Section 307/34 of IPC and sentenced to undergo 7 years R.I. with fine of Rs.10,000/-, with default stipulation, which has wrongly been typed as "under Section 366 and 376 of IPC and sentenced to undergo 5 years R.I. and with fine of Rs.1000/-, and 7 years R.I.. with fine of Rs.1000/- with default stipulation.".
The mistake is apparent on the face of record, thus same is corrected.

Para - 2 of the order dated 31.05.2024 shall be read as "The appellant has been convicted under Section 307/34 of IPC and sentenced to undergo 7 years R.I. with fine of Rs.10,000/-, with default stipulation."
Accordingly, I.A.No.12814/2024 stands disposed off.

This order shall be read conjointly with the order dated 31.05.2024.
 (VIVEK RUSIA) (MILIND R  JUDGE   bj/-
